name: Recursive Form
description: At the start of each of its turns, Esix creates 3 fractal echoes — shimmering geometric duplicates. When Esix is targeted by an attack roll, roll a d6 for each remaining echo. If any of the d6s rolls a 3 or higher, one of the duplicates is hit instead of it, and the duplicate is destroyed. Echoes last until the start of Esix’s next turn.
